mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand environment that triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS declines, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the correlation between RSAFS change and SPX returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a stagflationary environment that pressures corporate margins and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and HOUST declines, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03.
